evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~420-425 °C, implausibly high vs. column 69-84 °C, but drifts smoothly; likely a sensor/scaling artifact rather than process
Stable column profile, gentle top-section cooling (T712 70.7→69.8, T705 76.8→69.0) consistent with steady total/partial reflux operation
Reflux ~0.33 L/h, distillate ~0.25 L/h, ratio noisy 2.7-3.9 but steady in mean
Pressure ~599 mbar and dP steady, no blockage or leak signature

args.missing_evidence: A composition/purity measurement of the distillate, and confirmation of T701 calibration/scaling (reboiler temperature reference)
